note: Town of Fort Kent municipal RV park at Riverside Park, off Dufour St at the confluence of the Fish and St. John rivers; self-contained rigs. Park also has a boat landing, pavilion, trail and playground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed town-run, 14 self-contained sites, phone reservations through the police. Town posts no rate, hookups or season. Note trimmed.
flags: RATE UNREAD: the town's page posts none, and I read no operator figure. Search summaries only, not opened: The Dyrt $35, Allstays $20-25, a July 2025 review $43; the same summaries disagree on site count (8, 11, 14) and hookups. The town has a web page, so your camper-report rule doesn't apply. Worth a call to 207-834-5678.

HOOKUPS UNSET, contradiction: the town calls it 'Self-Contained'. Stored inclusion_evidence says 50A/W/S (RVparky), and search summaries say water and electric, or water, electric and sewer. Not written.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. Imagery: herringbone pads in open grass, ~20 m from a continuous wooded band ~40-60 m deep along the St. John. No water visible from pad level on imagery. Google calls the park 'right on the river' (the park, not the pads). If an official or camper photo shows river through the trees, that would earn riverview; I found none.
PIN OK: stored 47.25474,-68.59385 is on the pad loop.
REVIEWS: Google 4.5/18, all about the park rather than the RV sites. 'Lots of parking, easy to get to, playground, bost launch, RV parking.'
